
---
title: "Map"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
mallards <- read_csv(
  "data/mallards.csv",
  col_types = cols(
    timestamp = col_datetime(format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
  )
) |>
  mutate(
    month = month(timestamp, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE),
    month_num = month(timestamp),
    year = year(timestamp),
    season = factor(
      case_when(
        month_num %in% 3:5 ~ "Spring",
        month_num %in% 6:8 ~ "Summer",
        month_num %in% 9:11 ~ "Autumn",
        TRUE ~ "Winter"
      ),
      levels = c("Spring", "Summer", "Autumn", "Winter")
    )
  )

write_rds(mallards, "data/mallards.rds")
```

```{r}
mallards |>
  count(duck_id, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
mallards |>
  summarize(
    minimum_latitude = min(lat, na.rm = TRUE),
    maximum_latitude = max(lat, na.rm = TRUE),
    minimum_longitude = min(long, na.rm = TRUE),
    maximum_longitude = max(long, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
mallards_region <- mallards |>
  filter(between(lat, 47, 55), between(long, 8, 25))

countries <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = countries, fill = "gray95", color = "gray70") +
  geom_point(
    data = mallards_region,
    aes(x = long, y = lat, color = duck_id),
    alpha = 0.5,
    size = 0.8
  ) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(8, 25), ylim = c(47, 55), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(color = "Individual duck") +
  theme_minimal()
```
